arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 200 measurement_concept_id, measurement_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(measurement_date) AS first_date, MAX(measurement_date) AS last_date FROM omop.measurement WHERE lower(measurement_source_value) LIKE '%hbe%' OR lower(measurement_source_value) LIKE '%hepatitis b e%' OR lower(measurement_source_value) LIKE '%hbv%' OR lower(measurement_source_value) LIKE '%hepatitis b virus%' GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, measurement_source_value ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 200 observation_concept_id, observation_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(observation_date) AS first_date, MAX(observation_date) AS last_date FROM omop.observation WHERE lower(observation_source_value) LIKE '%hbe%' OR lower(observation_source_value) LIKE '%hepatitis b e%' OR lower(observation_source_value) LIKE '%hbv%' OR lower(observation_source_value) LIKE '%hepatitis b virus%' GROUP BY observation_concept_id, observation_source_value ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 200 drug_concept_id, drug_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_date, MAX(drug_exposure_start_date) AS last_date FROM omop.drug_exposure WHERE lower(drug_source_value) LIKE '%tenofovir%' OR lower(drug_source_value) LIKE '%adefovir%' OR lower(drug_source_value) LIKE '%entecavir%' OR lower(drug_source_value) LIKE '%lamivudine%' OR lower(drug_source_value) LIKE '%telbivudine%' GROUP BY drug_concept_id, drug_source_value ORDER BY n DESC

arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 200 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND concept_class_id='Ingredient' AND (LOWER(concept_name) IN ('tenofovir','adefovir','entecavir','lamivudine','telbivudine') OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'tenofovir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'adefovir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'entecavir%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'lamivudine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'telbivudine%') ORDER BY concept_name

SELECT measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(measurement_date) AS first_date, MAX(measurement_date) AS last_date FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (37172394,37398481,4209123,44790061,37208992,3026949,3027346,3049385,3052981,36660207,3043634,3046542,3048505,3022058,3032567,3014700,4007817) GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT condition_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients, COUNT(*) AS records FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id WHERE condition_concept_id IN (439674,192240,35205770,35205769,44829751,44833242,44830943,44829749,3654685,37175349) GROUP BY condition_concept_id, c.concept_name ORDER BY patients DESC
